mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.title, r.cover_url, u.nickname AS author_name, r.favorite_count FROM favorite f JOIN recipe r ON r.id = f.recipe_id AND r.deleted = 0 JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
